jobs.title: IT Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description: Nordic Investin is recruiting an IT Service Delivery Manager on behalf of one of our partner companies. You know that dependable IT service comes from clear ownership, capable teams and honest performance data. The partner needs a service delivery leader for business critical workplace and infrastructure services. You will manage performance, suppliers and continual improvement while keeping the experience of employees and business teams visible. The work spans organisational boundaries and requires both technical understanding and disciplined communication. Decisions must remain useful when they reach delivery teams, suppliers and operational owners. How you will work You will work across teams with different incentives, technical histories and decision rights. The partner expects concise preparation, visible dependencies and follow through after meetings. Strong performance means that people understand what was decided, why it matters and what they now own. As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. The role still includes hands on delivery; seniority here means broader judgement, not distance from the work. What you will do Own service performance, reviews and improvement plans. Coordinate internal teams and external service providers. Manage major incident communication and follow up. Improve service levels, measures and operational reporting. Oversee change, capacity, continuity and lifecycle risks. Build trusted relationships with business service owners. What you will bring Senior IT service delivery or operations management experience. Strong ITIL knowledge applied pragmatically. Supplier, SLA and commercial management ability. Experience leading major incident and problem management. Clear reporting and stakeholder communication. Professional English; Swedish may be required for local operations. Experience that would add value Workplace, network or cloud service responsibility. Service transition after outsourcing or transformation. Experience managing distributed or international delivery. A background that can succeed here You may have progressed through infrastructure operations, service management, supplier governance or technical support leadership. The partner values leaders who can discuss service evidence in detail and still keep attention on the people affected. What makes the opportunity interesting You will have the mandate to improve how services are run rather than only report their status. The role offers broad relationships, visible operational outcomes and meaningful influence over suppliers and future service design. The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time. The recruitment conversation During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap. How to apply Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Developer
jobs.description: Nordic Investin is recruiting a ServiceNow Developer on behalf of one of our partner companies. You want to develop ServiceNow as a serious enterprise platform, with clean configuration, useful automation and code that remains supportable. The partner operates a large ServiceNow environment that supports customer delivery and internal work. You will join an agile team developing existing capabilities and introducing new modules at a steady pace. The work spans organisational boundaries and requires both technical understanding and disciplined communication. Decisions must remain useful when they reach delivery teams, suppliers and operational owners. How you will work You will work across teams with different incentives, technical histories and decision rights. The partner expects concise preparation, visible dependencies and follow through after meetings. Strong performance means that people understand what was decided, why it matters and what they now own. You will receive meaningful ownership while working with senior colleagues on the most consequential decisions. The partner expects you to deliver independently within a clear area, ask for context early and contribute ideas grounded in what you observe. There is room to deepen your specialism or broaden toward adjacent responsibilities. What you will do Configure and develop workflows, forms and business logic. Build integrations using APIs, IntegrationHub and platform capabilities. Create maintainable scripts and scoped applications. Write automated tests and support controlled releases. Investigate platform issues and performance concerns. Collaborate with process owners and translate needs into platform solutions. What you will bring Professional ServiceNow development experience. JavaScript and platform scripting ability. Knowledge of data models, ACLs and application scope. Experience with integrations and REST APIs. Understanding of agile delivery and source control practices. Professional English; Swedish is required for some partner environments. Experience that would add value ITSM, CSM, HRSD or another major ServiceNow module. ServiceNow certifications. Experience in a large multi department installation. A background that can succeed here Your background may be platform administration, JavaScript development, IT service management or consulting. The partner values developers who understand the process impact of a change and resist unnecessary customisation. What makes the opportunity interesting You will work on a mature platform with an ambitious roadmap and experienced colleagues. The role provides variety across configuration, code, integration and direct business collaboration. jobs.title: Filed Service Manager - Scanjet in Gothenburg or Sjöbo
jobs.description: About Scanjet Scanjet Marine & System AB, a part of the Alfa Laval Group, is a world-leading and innovative company working with equipment for cleaning and level sensing for marine and land-based oil and chemical tanks. Scanjet was started in 1987 in Sweden where the headquarter remains today. Scanjet has sister companies with sites in Bulgaria, the Netherlands, Poland, Norway, the UK, Shanghai and Indonesia. With these strategic geographical locations and a strong customer focus, we have successfully established ourselves as a world leader in our sector. We have a major focus on future products designed to meet strict industry standards as well as environmental requirements. In our everyday work we are guided by our core values; customer-focused, professional and committed, cost-efficient, and keeping our promises. We are a workplace for everyone, and our success is built on a culture of diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from various backgrounds and experiences. Scanjet is now looking for Field Service Manager to join our After sales organisation. About the role This role is responsible for leading Scanjet's Service organisation consisting of 20 employees, Field Service Engineers and Service Coordinators, across Europe and Asia. In this role you will report to the CEO, work closely with other managers within Aftersales and other parts of Scanjet as well as interact with Alfa Laval service & AS organisations. The position is full-time and will be based in either Gothenburg or Sjöbo in Sweden. In this role you can expect to travel approximately 60 days per year. Key responsibilities Lead Scanjet's global Service organisation, with overall responsibility for people, performance, budget, and sustainable business growth. Drive Scanjets cooperation with Alfa Laval's Marine A/S organization in Business Unit MAS and Framo and make sure that best practice is used. Develop and maintain a professional, customer-focused service network for Tank Management. Foster a strong customer-centric culture across the Service organisation. Drive the continuous development of global service operations, ensuring efficiency, safety, regulatory compliance, and high service quality. Lead the implementation of tools, processes, and ways of working that improve operational effectiveness and customer value. Lead, coach, and support team members throughout the employee lifecycle, creating an engaging and inclusive work environment. Oversee service partner agreements, competence development, and service documentation to ensure quality and consistency. Qualifications To succeed in this role, we believe you have the following required qualifications: Relevant education or equivalent work experience. Proven experience leading a service organisation or a company where service is a core business offering. Strong business acumen and commercial mindset. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across different countries, cultures, and regulatory environments. Solution-oriented, positive, and collaborative, prestige-free attitude. Proactive, and results-driven with a hands-on approach. Flexible mindset and ability to adapt and thrive in an international environment. Professional proficiency in both English and Swedish, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment. Not a requirement but nice to have: Experience in a leadership or manager role, with demonstrated responsibility for driving business performance and organizational development Hands-on experience managing field service operations within a mechanical and/or electrical engineering environment. What we offer At Scanjet, you will join a friendly and dynamic workplace with an entrepreneurial spirit. You will have the chance to collaborate and grow together with committed colleagues and to contribute toward the future development and success of Scanjet. We have a strong track record of internal career development
